items.exampleEn: There was a sneer on his face when he saw my old bike.
items.exampleZh: 他看到我的舊腳踏車時，臉上露出一抹冷笑。

items.exampleEn: The old man looked fondly at his horse.
items.exampleZh: 那位老人深情地看著他的馬。

items.exampleEn: This old photo is one of my most cherished possessions.
items.exampleZh: 這張老照片是我最珍愛的東西之一。

items.exampleEn: Her unhappiness at work was clear to everyone.
items.exampleZh: 大家都看得出她在工作上不快樂。

items.exampleEn: His glee at winning the prize was easy to see.
items.exampleZh: 他得獎的喜悅一看就知道。

items.exampleEn: She stubbornly kept her old phone for ten years.
items.exampleZh: 她固執地用那支舊手機用了十年。

items.exampleEn: After losing the match, he was in a funk for days.
items.exampleZh: 輸了比賽之後，他沮喪了好幾天。

items.exampleEn: Her impulsive answer surprised the teacher.
items.exampleZh: 她衝動的回答讓老師嚇了一跳。

items.sentenceEn: The children shouted with glee when they saw the snow.
items.sentenceZh: 孩子們看到雪時開心地大叫。

items.audioEn: The donkey stubbornly refused to cross the bridge, so we had to take the long way.
items.audioZh: 那頭驢子固執地不肯過橋，所以我們只好繞遠路。
options: The animal would not go on

items.sentenceEn: He still thinks fondly of his first teacher.
items.sentenceZh: 他至今仍深情地想起他的啟蒙老師。

items.sentenceEn: This band plays a lively mix of jazz and funk.
items.sentenceZh: 這個樂團演奏爵士和放克的活潑混合曲風。

items.stemEn: Buying a car on the same day you first see it is a very ____ decision.
items.stemZh: 第一次看到車當天就買下來，是非常衝動的決定。

items.stemEn: He ____ refused to say sorry, even when everyone asked him to.
items.stemZh: 即使大家都要他道歉，他還是固執地拒絕。

items.passageEn: My grandmother has a cherished cup that she brought from her hometown sixty years ago. She often speaks fondly of the day she got it. Last month, my little brother, who can be very impulsive, picked it up to play with it, and it fell. For a moment, nobody spoke. Then he saw the unhappiness on her face and started to cry. Luckily, only the lid had broken. When my uncle fixed it, my brother jumped with glee.
items.passageZh: 我祖母有一個很珍愛的杯子，是她六十年前從家鄉帶來的。她常常懷念地談起得到它的那一天。上個月，我那很容易衝動的弟弟把杯子拿起來玩，結果掉到地上。有一會兒大家都沒說話。接著他看到祖母臉上的難過，就哭了出來。幸好只有蓋子破了。叔叔把它修好時，弟弟高興得跳了起來。

questions.questionZh: 杯子掉下來後，哪裡破了？

items.promptZh: 他冷笑了一聲，然後轉身離開。
referenceEn: He gave a sneer and then turned and walked away.
With a sneer, he turned around and left.
rubricZh: 要用 sneer（例如 gave a sneer、with a sneer、sneered 等）
「轉身離開」可寫，例如 turned and walked away、turned around and left 等
時態可用過去式或現在式（例如 gave、gives 等）

items.promptZh: 她一時衝動，把頭髮剪得很短。
referenceEn: She made an impulsive decision to cut her hair very short.
In an impulsive moment, she had her hair cut very short.
rubricZh: impulsive 當形容詞（例如 an impulsive decision、in an impulsive moment 等）
「把頭髮剪得很短」可寫，例如 cut her hair very short、had her hair cut short 等
時態可用過去式或現在完成式（例如 made、has cut 等）
